bullets.text: The Madras High Court declined to quash a development ban within a one-kilometer zone around Pallikaranai marsh.
PMK leader Anbumani urged the Tamil Nadu government to stop construction work like compound walls and walkways in Pallikaranai marsh.
Avadi City Police arrested three persons for grabbing 1.59 acres of land worth about two crore rupees using fabricated documents.
TANGEDCO enforcement officials detected twenty-four cases of power theft in areas including Avadi and collected fifty-two point seventy-seven lakh rupees.
Karnataka held a Data Centre Roundtable at the Bengaluru Tech Summit 2026 to operationalize a one thousand megawatt sustainable roadmap.

takeaways: The Madras High Court refused to quash the 1km development ban around the Pallikaranai marsh.
Builders must now approach the Supreme Court if they wish to challenge the wetland restrictions.

takeaways: PMK leader Anbumani Ramadoss urged the Tamil Nadu government to stop construction work in Pallikaranai marsh.
The opposition party demanded an immediate halt to retaining walls and pathways inside the wetland.

stories.title: Avadi police arrest three persons involved in ₹2-crore land fraud
takeaways: Avadi City Police arrested three individuals for grabbing 1.59 acres of land worth Rs 2 crore in Kovilpathagai.
The accused used fabricated legal heir certificates to fraudulently transfer property ownership.

takeaways: Karnataka convened a high-level Data Centre Roundtable at the Bengaluru Tech Summit.
The session operationalized the new sustainable data centre policy in consultation with industry leaders.
